name: Montclair State University & Yogi Berra Museum Youth Camp
operator_name: Montclair State University Baseball and Yogi Berra Museum & Learning Center
description_short: Weeklong baseball camp for players of all abilities ages 6 to 13 at Yogi Berra Stadium on the Montclair State University campus, taught by MSU coaches and players. Campers work on hitting, defense, base running and pitching, play games, and spend part of one day in the Yogi Berra Museum next to the field.
notes: 9 to 3, Monday to Friday. $450.50 per camper ($425 plus $25.50 in fees). Optional pizza lunch $42.50 a week; otherwise bring a lunch. Campers bring their own glove, bat, helmet and cleats. Group discount codes from the Montclair State Baseball office. Indoor space is used in bad weather.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Museum camps page: youth baseball camp with Red Hawk Baseball at Montclair State's Yogi Berra Stadium, next to the museum; indoor facilities in bad weather. Address is the museum's (8 Yogi Berra Dr., Little Falls, NJ 07424, on the MSU campus); the stadium is beside it. This page still shows the 2026 weeks.

Researched by Claude from this page. Montclair State Baseball's registration page, linked as 'Register here' from the museum: 2027 weeks July 12 to 16, August 16 to 20 and August 23 to 27, ages 6 to 13, 9 to 3, $450.50 including fees, optional lunch $42.50. The description paragraph on the same page says ages 7 to 13; the session details all say 6 to 13.
